# diy-fido-key

A DIY USB-connected FIDO2/WebAuthn passkey device (a homemade YubiKey) made by flashing an inexpensive off-the-shelf ESP32 board with `pico-fido` firmware.

Source: <https://www.makeuseof.com/made-own-yubikey-less-than-8/>

## Target hardware / prerequisites

- **ESP32-S2 or ESP32-S3** (USB-OTG device mode is required)
- ⚠ **ESP32-C3, original ESP32, C6, and H2 are not supported** (no USB-OTG peripheral)
- A browser (for the web flasher at `picokeys.com/esp32-flasher/`)

## What it does

The full feature set of `pico-fido` (CTAP 2.3 / CTAP 1 / WebAuthn / U2F / ECDSA and EdDSA with multiple curves / YubiKey-style OTP emulation) lets it be used from a PC as a genuine USB security key.

## Setup

```
1. Prepare an ESP32-S2/S3 board (about $6–8)
2. Open https://picokeys.com/esp32-flasher/
3. Enter bootloader mode with BOOT+RESET and connect from the browser
4. Select the "Pico Fido" firmware and write it
5. Plug into a PC; it is recognized as an HID authenticator
6. Patch VID/PID with the PicoKey App (for compatibility with OpenSC/ykman/GnuPG)
```

## Constraints

- **No FIDO authentication and no secure element.** Limited to personal use, experiments, and backup keys
- Firmware is **AGPLv3**

Added an ESP32-S3 board (with a 0.96-inch ST7735 80×160 IPS display) as a real device with USB-OTG.

# SvitloBoard

SvitloBoard is firmware for ESP8266 and ESP32 that reports device availability to the [СвітлоБот](https://svitlobot.in.ua) service. The device itself does not keep charts, does not manage a Telegram channel, and does not determine the cause of unavailability. СвітлоБот handles that logic.

## How it works

After the first boot, the board creates a Wi-Fi network `SvitloBoard-XXXXXX` with the password `svitlobot`. In the local web interface, you need to specify:

1. the primary Wi-Fi network and, if needed, up to two backup networks;
2. if needed, the Channel Key obtained from СвітлоБот (it can be added later);
3. an optional administrator password for the local interface.

After saving, the board connects to Wi-Fi and periodically sends HTTPS requests to СвітлоБот. If the primary network is unavailable, the firmware checks the backup networks. If none of them works, the board reopens its access point so the settings can be corrected, without erasing the saved configuration.

ArguMesh (Chinese name: 论脉) is a **local-first, open-source** literature research workbench for researchers, graduate students, and paper authors. From literature to paper writing, every step keeps its evidence traceable.

It reduces repeatedly moving information between PDF readers, spreadsheets, note-taking software, and chat-style AI.

- **Local SQLite**: zero cloud dependency, no account or login required.
- **Optional AI**: bring your own model API; the manual workflow works without any configuration.
- **You confirm the content**: AI suggestions keep their sources, and confirmed and locked evidence is protected.

## 🤝 Acknowledgments

Thanks to [StepFun (阶跃星辰)](https://www.stepfun.com/) for its support during development and evaluation.

## Problems Solved

| Common problem | How ArguMesh handles it |
| --- | --- |
| Papers are scattered across folders, browsers, and note-taking apps, making them hard to manage by topic | Use Project to isolate topics and literature, with search, filtering, and tags; after binding a workspace, **`literature/` folder sync** imports PDFs in bulk without uploading |
| Reading tends to stop at highlights and abstracts, so it can't be reused later | In the PDF reader, save selections as Note, Claim, or Evidence, preserving the paper and page number |
| Uploading an entire paper directly to AI leaves the scope of the answers opaque | Reading Q&A submits only the original text, page numbers, and questions the user actively selects; bilingual side-by-side view submits only the paragraphs of the current page, and only after the user clicks 「精确解析并翻译全文」 (Precisely parse and translate full text). The whole paper is never uploaded |
| Comparing multiple papers with manual tables leads to inconsistent dimensions and lost evidence sources | The evidence matrix uses papers as columns and research dimensions as rows; evidence can be verified, confirmed, locked, or marked as conflicting |
| Notes, gaps, ideas, and research questions are scattered across multiple tools | The research context unifies insights and research questions, and preserves their provenance |
| Experiments and writing are disconnected from evidence | Experiment result analysis and LaTeX writing cite project evidence and can jump back to workspace objects |
| The process of AI batch jobs is not visible, making failures hard to trace | The task center and Research Agent record scope, model, actions, and results |

| Literature | DOI / arXiv / PDF import, folder sync, reading and annotation |

# WuxinBot

An extensible AI Agent for QQ group chats, based on OneBot v11.

WuxinBot combines open-ended conversation, deterministic message routing, and bounded tool calls in one runtime. Explicit commands and high-confidence data queries are handled directly by code. The LLM is used only when understanding context or choosing a tool is required. It is not an autonomous agent that plans and executes tasks without limit, and it is not just a chat bot that forwards group messages to a model as-is.

The current release uses **pippi** as the default interactive persona. pippi is a presentation-layer persona setting, not the project definition of WuxinBot.

V2.0 adds per-group coordinated natural replies, plus affinity, recent mood, and forms of address and tone that the LLM decides and updates. The Owner is permanently displayed as "特殊" (Special). Command permissions are checked against real identity and source, not by keyword judgment.

View status, rankings, decisions, usage, and correction records under Console "More → 接话与好感 (Replies & Affinity)". After upgrading, the master switch is off by default. Once enabled, it follows the existing per-group switches and participation modes. Only the Owner can use `/w 好感度 [@成员或 QQ]` to query relationships, `/w 好感榜` to see this group's ranking, and `/w 好感榜 全局` to see the global ranking (private chat defaults to global). Tied scores share a rank, and the Owner is listed separately as "特殊". Use `/w 指令 set 名称 内容`, `/w 指令 revoke 名称`, and `/w 指令 list` to manage long-term instructions for the current session. For the design, see [`V2 规划`](https://github.com/GH-Wuxin/WuxinBot/blob/HEAD/docs/WUXINBOT_V2_PLAN.md). For implementation and acceptance, see [`实施记录`](https://github.com/GH-Wuxin/WuxinBot/blob/HEAD/docs/V2_IMPLEMENTATION.md).

## Desktop Client

WuxinBot now provides a native Electron desktop client. It reuses the existing console UI and manages WuxinBot, NapCat, PP+, and other local components from the "运行控制 (Run Control)" page. The client supports Windows login auto-start, start and stop for individual processes, batch restart, and ending managed processes when the window is closed.

```powershell
npm run desktop:dev       # 开发模式 (development mode)
npm run desktop:build     # 生成 Windows 安装包 (build Windows installer)
```

For details, see [`docs/DESKTOP_CLIENT.md`](https://github.com/GH-Wuxin/WuxinBot/blob/HEAD/docs/DESKTOP_CLIENT.md).

# Sports Anti-Doping Teaching Platform

Provides international case search, database analysis, prohibited lists, a TUE decision tool, quizzes, and doping control procedures.
Official site: https://antidopingplatform.sportsmedicine.tw/

## Prescription Drug, Chinese Medicine, and Supplement Lookup

Three new lookup types are added: `/drug-search` covers 66,522 TFDA prescription drug licenses; `/herbal-search` covers 10,046 NHI Administration Chinese medicine entries (single herb 3,507 / compound 6,539); `/supplement-search` covers 7,972 TFDA food registrations. All support search, pagination, detail views, and SQLite/JSON portability, and none depend on supply data from the original TADA site. Prescription drugs include component-by-component comparison for some listed substances. Chinese medicine data lacks complete formulas, and food data lacks batch-level doping test certificates, so none of these are presumed to be usable by athletes. This is not a one-to-one replica of TADA's full data or full interpretation.

For usage, sources, licensing, actual coverage, and portability instructions, see [Lookup System Implementation Report](https://github.com/keanu77/antidopingplatform/blob/HEAD/docs/research/2026-10-23-drug-system/README.md). During local development and builds, indexes are automatically generated from three compressed snapshots under version control. Full verification records are in the report appendix.

The current working version contains 517 teaching cases: 500 newly added and 17 existing cases corrected or split. Scenarios include violations, contamination, legitimate TUEs, cases where no charge was filed, and sanctions that were overturned. The case count should not be taken as a count of violators or a prevalence rate.

naamfung/dsc.body:
# DSC

This project is a programming agent system implemented in Golang. It follows the design philosophy of DeepSeek Harness, in which everything is a plugin, and plugins can be loaded or unloaded through hot-plugging.

## Clone Guide

General users should download the official release binary directly. For development, clone the **master** branch:

```bash
git clone -b master https://github.com/naamfung/dsc.git
```

## Core Features

- **Plugin architecture**: A host-and-plugin communication mechanism based on `go-plugin` and gRPC, supporting hot-plug loading or unloading.
- **Hot Reload**: Supports online hot reload of five plugin types: dsc / agent / llm / tool / policy, allowing plugin versions to be updated without restarting the main program. It almost never holds a global lock, and a failure does not affect the old instance.
- **Multiple LLM support**: Supports mainstream LLM providers such as OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama. Among them, the `llm-openai` and `llm-anthropic` plugins support the local LlamaCpp inference engine.
- **ReAct loop**: Implements the Reasoning and Acting loop for agents, supporting multi-turn reasoning and tool execution.
- **Tool invocation and plugin extensibility**: Supports extending the toolset through Tool plugins, with built-in file operations and shell execution. The sandbox policy has three levels (aligned with the DSH sandbox mode): `read-only` (rejects all file writes), `workspace-write` (allows writes only inside the workspace root, default), and `full-access` (the entire filesystem is writable). It can be switched at runtime in the TUI via `/sandbox read-only | workspace | full-access`. The workspace root defaults to the directory where dsc was launched (it can also be overridden with an absolute path via `workspace_root`). This root is always **normalized to forward slashes** before being injected into each plugin process, embedded in tool results, and included in sandbox prompts. This prevents Windows backslashes (such as the native form returned by `os.Getwd()`) from entering the model context and inducing the model to copy backslashes into paths. Writes using relative paths under each file always resolve from the workspace root (to prevent `../` path traversal). Writes to absolute paths outside the workspace are uniformly governed by the sandbox policy. `read-only` also disables interpreters and executors whose read-only status cannot be determined from their arguments (such as shell), to prevent `echo x > /anywhere` from bypassing the read-only restriction.
